title: tc-policy-simulator
description:
A dry run of an action against a policy set: the decision, the rule that decided it, the reason and a step-by-step
rule trace. Nothing executes.

heading.description: The heading, and the form's name

action.description: The action to try, in words or as a tool call, e.g. "Send the Q3 report to an external address"

ruleClass.description: The id of the picked rule class; unset picks the first

context.description: Optional context the rules can read, e.g. "amount: 4,800 · recipient: outside the company"

ruleClasses.description: The rule classes to pick from

examples.description: Ready-made actions shown as chips above the form; [] hides them

result.description: The result shown – set by a run, or by the app (after preventing tc-simulate)

decisionLabels.description: The decisions' names, merged over the defaults (Allow, Needs approval, Deny, Hard stop)

contextLabel.description: The context field's label; the field is optional

requiredLabel.description: Shown when Simulate is pressed with no action

errorLabel.description: Shown when `evaluate` throws or its promise rejects

dryRunLabel.description: The reminder next to Simulate that nothing runs

description.description: One quiet line shown under the field when this class is picked

PolicySimExample.description: A ready-made action the person can try with one click

source.description: Where the rule lives, e.g. "Outbound policy · v12"

rule.description: The rule's name, e.g. "External send over limit"

ruleId.description: Its id – the step whose id is the result's `rule.id` is marked as the deciding one

detail.description: Why it did or didn't apply, in a few words

decision.description: What this rule would decide, for a matched rule

ms.description: How long the check took, in ms

PolicyTraceStep.description: One rule checked, in the order the policy set checked it

PolicyTraceOutcome.description: "matched": the rule applied; "no-match": checked, didn't apply; "skipped": not checked (another class, or after the decision)
